rawContent: Yes! This is great! Thank you NJ Officers for taking part and joining those protesting for justice and for wanting change with supporting black lives! There is fucking hope! There’s hope! 🙌🏼🖤🤘🏼🖤 #BlackLivesMatter #rebellionsarebuildonhope

Everyone still going out protesting this week, please stay safe and take care of each other. Keep signing petitions, donating to the causes to help the peaceful fighting going, keep making art out there, be safe. #BlackLivesMatter #ArtIsTheWeapon

I’m standing with others who are taking part in both #BlackOutTuesday and #amplifymelanatedvoices for this time being. My social media silent, my Etsy Store put on vacation until after the 7th of June. Take care of another, Be safe out there, Love you all. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/qKJvxQ0dwj
